be9e402b-8d3b-58da-9766-2cf2ec25b9ae.content: Calculate user research compensation budgets based on the estimated participation burden, combining session time with required technical and travel preparation.

85157c57-410f-5c7d-8183-b37d61eebf8a.content: Compensate participants who withdraw from the study midway for their actual participation time.

8abeab95-3e41-5378-8409-08200aee9d58.content: Compensate for the time actually spent in sessions, regardless of the research modality.

9b59c6ed-5dbe-5ccc-87b5-6be31f414e68.content: Allow the issuance of gift cards of equivalent value to participants in remote studies who cannot use electronic transfers.

5c6c461d-05e5-5b0c-b801-245de2f9c8d7.content: Do not treat an unresolved payment method as a deficiency at the proposal stage.

44abc098-8c9f-5abb-bc49-9deb25066d93.content: Allow differential compensation amounts for on-site and remote studies when participation burden varies due to travel or technical preparation.

2a252668-f3f2-5582-b248-43ad81c54a48.content: Participants judge the fairness of compensation based on the combined burden of session time and required technical and travel preparation.

7e647a83-81b0-52d6-9362-e513dc2a5032.content: In longitudinal studies requiring diary entries and repeated reporting, include out-of-session recording time in compensation calculations.

d77affab-60c8-5403-b189-17022b484640.content: Distinguish between participant research compensation and labor costs for field staff performing installation and operational support as part of their duties.

0c470c6b-26a6-5501-93ac-c51fecd708ae.content: The user tends to count session time but omit participants’ advance setup and follow-up reporting time.
